create_RotatedBoxes: create a RotatedBoxes object from a Nx5 tensor of (x_center, y_center, width, height, angle) boxes
compute_RotatedBoxes_area: compute the area of all rotated boxes from a RotatedBoxes tensor
clip_RotatedBoxes: clip near-horizontal rotated boxes to image boundaries in place
compute_rotated_IoU: compute pairwise IoU between all N x M pairs of rotated boxes
scale_RotatedBoxes: scale rotated boxes with different horizontal and vertical factors
